summary: Frontend testing of Partner Yoga image feature and Light Codes image update feature. Partner Yoga is fully working with all 8 pose images visible. Light Codes has a critical data issue: 13 out of 75 symbols still serve generic placeholder images from MongoDB (stale data not re-seeded after divination_content.py was updated).

critical.issue: 13 out of 75 light code symbols return generic placeholder image URLs (pexels-photo-2098428 and pexels-photo-1169754) instead of authentic, energetically accurate images. Root cause: MongoDB light_codes collection was NOT re-seeded after divination_content.py was updated. The startup seeding in server.py only runs when yoga_poses collection is empty (line 108-114), so updated file changes never reach the database.

action_items: CRITICAL: Force re-seed the light_codes MongoDB collection with updated data from divination_content.py. The database has stale data because startup seeding only runs when yoga_poses is empty. Fix: Add a separate check for light_codes version or force-update the light_codes collection on startup regardless of yoga_poses count. The divination_content.py already has correct non-generic URLs for all 13 affected symbols.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L108-114: The startup seeding conditional (if yoga_count == 0) means that any updates to data files (like divination_content.py) are NEVER applied to an already-seeded database. This is a systemic issue - any content updates require either a DB reset or a force-reseed mechanism.

divination_content.py: The LIGHT_CODES data already has correct non-generic URLs for all 13 affected items. The fix is simply to update the MongoDB collection. No code changes needed in divination_content.py.
server.py: Consider adding light_codes-specific seeding with a force flag or version check to allow content updates without full DB reset.

rca_of_issue: Root Cause: MongoDB light_codes collection has stale data. The startup_seed_database() function in server.py (lines 103-116) only triggers a full database seed when the yoga_poses collection is empty (if yoga_count == 0). Since the database already has yoga poses, the updated divination_content.py with new image URLs is never applied to the MongoDB light_codes collection. The divination_content.py ALREADY has the correct authentic image URLs for all 13 affected items - the fix only requires force-updating the MongoDB collection. Mitigation: Either (1) add specific light_codes version checking and re-seeding, (2) use an environment variable to force re-seed, or (3) directly run a MongoDB update script for the 13 affected items.

Light Codes at /light-codes: Page loads, categories work, but 13/75 symbols have stale generic placeholder images from MongoDB.
